thread:
Ivy (AE): hey team, POC update for MapleHealth in Canada — they tried to pin model `llamax-v2` in ca-west but calls return `model_not_found` (404). customer is asking if we can fallback to a quantized variant and what Dedicated pricing would look like for their expected 2k reqs/min. also they require HSM-backed KMS. can we swarm?
Samir: @Ivy could you paste the exact error payload? is this via Hosted API or Dedicated trial?
Ivy (AE): Hosted API for now. error body: \n\n```
HTTP 404
{"error":"model_not_found","message":"model lllamax-v2 not available in region ca-west"}
```
They spelled it same as catalog name. Customer pasted the model name they received from our UI.
Maria S: looks like catalog has `llamax-v2` in us-west and eu-west but not ca-west — we recently deprecated the ca quant build during rollout. Did we not sync region availability?
deploy-bot: catalog-sync job 2023-11-14T02:12Z FAILED (502 upstream). retry scheduled +30m.
Andy P: this explains 404 — routing tries region-specific artifact and fails when the artifact isn't in region. fallback only works to compatible model variants that are registered in same region.
Samir: options: 1) immediate soft-fallback — route to us-west instance (increases latency) 2) provision a CA replica (takes ~48h) 3) suggest customer use a generic `llamax-v2-cpu-quant` variant in hosted if available.
Ivy (AE): customer worried about PII leaving CA. they asked about Dedicated in-region capacity and confirm HSM KMS for keys. what's the quickest way to give them a PoC-safe answer on latency + price?
Maria S: for Dedicated: rough rule — small reserved pool (1-2 GPUs) for 2k rps is undersized; we should propose reserved slot with autoscale + burst. give them a conservative monthly estimate: $XXk for initial month including networking + HSM add-on. (I'll ping ops for exact quote).
Samir: on KMS/HSM: Private/Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS; HSM-backed signers can be configured but require SOC checklist & contract addendum. Security needs to sign off. timeline ~5 business days for onboarding.
Ivy (AE): can we do a temporary mitigant — enable cross-region fallback and log the data flows? need wording for security + legal.
Andy P: technically yes: set routing policy to region-preferred then region-fallback -> us-west. Add audit log flag to capture request region and model variant. That gives them the PoC behavior without immediate replication. Note: rate-limit semantics change if routed cross-region.
Maria S: also watch tokenization/quant differences — the quant variant may change output distribution. advise customer to run a quick eval on their prompt set. I can spin up eval harness.
Ivy (AE): perfect. action items: Maria to draft eval harness + compare outputs, Samir to confirm fallback config + latency delta, Andy to get ops estimate for Dedicated + HSM quote, I'll update customer and legal.
Samir: quick heads up — if catalog-sync doesn't recover, fallback won't be possible for pinned model IDs. I'll escalate the sync job to infra.
deploy-bot: catalog-sync retry started (job id: 9876)
Ivy (AE): thanks all. I'll update MapleHealth in 1h with mitigations and temp fallback plan. :thumbsup:
Maria S: noted, starting eval run now. will report results in this thread.
Samir: escalating to infra on-call for catalog replication, tagging `@infra-oncall`.
Andy P: I'll draft the Dedicated price range and HSM onboarding steps into a short doc for Ivy to share.
Ivy (AE): great — please @mention me when ready.
Maria S: eval quick result — sample prompt shows slight truncation on quant variant, attaching diff (short). recommend we show both outputs to customer.
Ivy (AE): excellent. I'll loop in customer legal and ask for temporary consent for cross-region fallback while we provision Dedicated.
